mentions.name: Mengi Cloud
mentions.description: A cloud platform for creating easy deployments on any cloud provider, built on the author's experience automating Kubernetes environments. It aims to let teams run their apps without deep Kubernetes knowledge, with a focus on migrating workloads between cloud providers, including moving away from the big US-owned clouds.
mentions.problem: Companies consistently want easy deployments without needing a degree-level knowledge of Kubernetes, and a growing number want to move away from US-owned cloud providers (the big three).
mentions.audience: Companies deploying apps without Kubernetes expertise, and people/companies looking to migrate away from the big US-owned cloud providers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Mengi Cloud (https://app.mengi.cloud) - For over 25 years I've been working in IT and automation and this is my attempt at finally starting a business doing what I do best.
